patterns.description: Customers frequently experience excessively long wait times for service or food.
Some customers report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
Customers occasionally encounter staff members with negative or unhelpful attitudes.
A few reviews mention other general negative experiences without specific categorization.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently experience excessively long wait times for service or food.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing during peak hours or inefficient workflow management.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently experience excessively long wait times for service or food.
root_causes.cause: Lack of proper training for staff on managing customer flow and order processing.

root_causes.pattern: Some customers report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent ingredient sourcing or preparation standards across shifts/cooks.

root_causes.pattern: Some customers report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Lack of consistent quality control checks on dishes before serving.

root_causes.pattern: Customers occasionally encounter staff members with negative or unhelpful attitudes.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training in customer service and conflict resolution.

root_causes.pattern: Customers occasionally encounter staff members with negative or unhelpful attitudes.
root_causes.cause: Low staff morale, high workload, or inadequate management support leading to burnout.

root_causes.pattern: A few reviews mention other general negative experiences without specific categorization.
root_causes.cause: General operational issues or isolated incidents not fitting into specific categories, possibly indicating a broader lack of attention to detail.
